test_title: PYST 35: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

P) once said

Q) a wise man

R) that action speaks

S) louder than words
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence conveys a famous saying about the importance of actions over words.
 
• **Part Q is the first part** as it introduces the subject, "a wise man":
 
 
• "a wise man"
 
 
 
• **Part P follows next** to indicate what the wise man did, "once said":
 
 
• "once said"
 
 
 
• **Part R is the third part** as it begins the quote, "that action speaks":
 
 
• "that action speaks"
 
 
 
• **Part S comes last** to complete the quote, "louder than words":
 
 
• "louder than words"
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **QPRS**.

 

**Coherent sentence after rearrangement**:

"A wise man once said that action speaks louder than words."
